card.name: Words just before a missing 'relationship' term
card.fires_on: Scattered words where a noun like relationship, interaction or comparison could come next, such as 'between two', 'on', 'into', or the end of a drug name in an interaction sentence. Mostly mid-sentence in drug-interaction and explanatory text.

modes.label: Drug names in interaction text
modes.description: Last piece of a drug name in a list or pair of co-administered drugs.

modes.label: Linking words before a noun
modes.description: Short prepositions or determiners that precede a noun about how two things relate.
modes.example: Canonical correlation is a method of modelling the relationship between<< two>> sets of variables.

modes.label: Nouns after 'other'
modes.description: Nouns such as drugs or dose in comparison phrases.
modes.example: The concomitant use of opioids with other<< drugs>> that affect the serotonergic neurotransmitter
